title: Konventix Platform
description: HTTP, queues, health, runtime and database for one release. Source: konventix-poc contrib/observability (ADR-0059).

panels.title: Version
panels.description: The deployed image tag, from the series label.

panels.title: Requests per second by status class
Jobs per minute: processed and failed
Log records per minute by level
Prompts
panels.description: Times somebody was asked to agree to something, in the selected range (ADR-0066).

panels.title: Grants
panels.description: Agreements recorded. Prompts and grants share one surface set so the two are comparable.

panels.title: Not agreed
panels.description: Derived from prompts against grants (D-CPL-17); the interstitial's "Not now" has no counter of its own. KonventixConsentGateBlocking fires when prompts run with no grant at all.

panels.title: Outstanding contract subjects
panels.description: People who still owe agreement to a published contract text.

panels.title: Door refusals
panels.description: KonventixEntryConditionRefusalsAtDoor fires above three in ten minutes.

panels.title: Prompts per hour by surface and reason
Grants against prompts per hour
panels.description: The refusal rate is the gap between the two — it is derived, never counted (D-CPL-17).

panels.title: Bound-policy matches per hour by kind
panels.description: Whether a bound text is actually being asked for. The kind is a label; the target never is.

panels.title: Reports (range)
panels.description: Counted once per selected category, so a report that ticks two boxes counts twice here (design §10.6).

panels.title: Purchase affected (range)
panels.description: KonventixSupportPurchaseAffected fires on the first one in ten minutes (D-SUP-06).

panels.title: Oldest unopened
panels.description: KonventixSupportUnseen fires at an hour. 0 when nothing is waiting.

panels.title: Open reports by brand
panels.description: The brand host the report came in on; `console` is a report filed on the operator console, which has no brand (ADR-0063).

panels.title: WAL archiving
panels.description: 1 when the last archive attempt failed after the last success.
